title: 赌球只有输赢：体育指数却全程计算，还能当ETF底层
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: So, Kalshi in Polymarket, I believe the most of the stuff going on there is sports, it's very popular. And you can bet on like anything throughout the game. I mean, it's wild, right?
segments.zh: Kalshi和Polymarket上大部分是体育，非常受欢迎。你可以对比赛中的任何事下注，很疯狂吧？

segments.en: Why do this? Like, how is this different or competing from just betting on the team or will someone score a goal? Because you can already do that.
segments.zh: 为什么这么做？这和直接赌球队赢或某人进球有什么不同或竞争？因为那些你已经可以做了。

segments.en: A bet is binary, so win or a loss. Our indexes calculate throughout the game, throughout the season, and they calculate whether there's a trade on it or not.
segments.zh: 赌注是二元的，赢或输。我们的指数在整个比赛、整个赛季中计算，无论是否有交易。

segments.en: So, aside from these being used as the basis for an ETF, what are other use cases for these indexes? How do you see them being applied? It's a benchmark, so it's a reference. And
segments.zh: 除了作为ETF的基础，这些指数还有哪些用途？你怎么看它们的应用？它是一个基准，所以是参考。

segments.en: journalists, sponsors, analysts now have a number to refer to for sports performance, and the businesses whose revenues are tied to the sports performance can now transfer their risk.
